hypotheses.S0_rank16_oracle_subspace_is_sufficient: The frozen FineWeb rank-16 newline-write subspace has oracle Fisher fidelity >=0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S1_compact_frontier_reaches_ood: Some rank <=32 reaches oracle fidelity >=0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S2_learned_subspace_beats_random: At rank 16, learned oracle fidelity exceeds an equal-rank random-subspace oracle by >=0.30 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S3_state_router_recovers_compact_module: At rank 16, FineWeb-trained state-predicted coefficients have fidelity >=0.70 and are within 0.15 of oracle-subspace fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.S4_router_beats_shuffled_coefficients: At rank 16, routed fidelity exceeds a shuffled-target ridge router by >=0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S5_subspace_repairs_wikitext_direction_r: On WikiText, rank-16 oracle fidelity exceeds the prior one-ray oracle by >=0.25.
